description: Wire a step's output handle to another step, to build or repair a branch (adding and removing steps keeps the plain chain on their own). A condition's 'false' handle starts unconnected, so a failing condition ends the run. Connecting a connected handle replaces its edge; target_step_id: null disconnects it.

branch.description: Which handle the edge leaves. Only a condition has branches: 'true' is the path taken when it holds and 'false' the path when it does not. Everything else uses null, its single onward edge.

source_step_id.description: The step the edge leaves (a step id from get_workflow). null means the trigger, i.e. the workflow entry.

target_step_id.description: The step the edge arrives at (a step id from get_workflow), or null to leave the handle unconnected.

workflow_id.description: Automation (workflow) UUID, from list_workflows or create_workflow.

name: connect_workflow_steps
title: Connect workflow steps
